title: Press to Gather - Configurable
author: Tic0311 and CamilleBC
summary: Hold B / Circle to gather nearby harvestable resources, or press O. Choose your controller button and a 10–200 m distance in the Mod Settings. Defaults: 0.6-second hold and 20 m. Supports Framecore UE4SS Performance mode.

file.name: Press to Gather - Configurable
file.description: Choose your gathering button in Mod Settings. Default: hold B / Circle for 0.6 seconds. Set the distance from 10 to 200 m in 10 m steps; default 20 m. Saved settings apply during play; keyboard O also gathers.

required.name: Mod Setting Menu
required.note: Required for live Apply. UE4SS HookProcessConsoleExec must be 1.

liveSettings.apply: Committed values update gameplay through bounded workers.
